questions.question_english: 94. In the context of global economics, what does 'Deglobalization' or 'Slowbalisation' refer to?

Rapid expansion of multilateral free trade agreements and open economic zones across continents
Complete regulatory elimination of national borders for international labor workforce migration

questions.explanation_english:
The Public Debt-to-GDP ratio measures a
country’s total accumulated sovereign debt
relative to its total annual economic output.

endangering fiscal stability. A lower ratio indicates
sustainable borrowing, whereas excessively high
ratios signal debt distress, higher borrowing

Frictional unemployment occurs when workers
are voluntarily or temporarily between jobs while
searching for new employment or transitioning
across career opportunities. It represents a
normal, short-term form of unemployment

lags required for job seekers to match with

questions.explanation_english: Monetary policy transmission begins when the central bank increases the repo rate, elevating borrowing costs for commercial banks.
